business_summary: Dhabriya Polywood Limited engages in the manufacture and supply of poly vinyl chloride (PVC) and unplasticized poly vinyl chloride (uPVC) products in India. The company operates in two segments, Plastic Product and Modular Furniture. It offers uPVC windows and doors system, aluminum windows and doors; PVC doors, wall panel, fencing, furniture, and foam board; SPC flooring; wall and ceiling fluted panels; plywood soffit ceiling and wall system panels; aluminum windows and doors; and extruded PVC profile sections and sheets, as well as moldings for various furnishing and furniture applications. It also provides modular furniture products. The company sells its products under the Polywood, Dynasty, and D-Stona, Everluxe and Studio Arezzo brands. It exports its products. Dhabriya Polywood Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Jaipur, India.
